title: microstylis decurrens
intro: Microstylis decurrens, commonly known as the Indian swamp orchid, is a species of orchid that belongs to the family Orchidaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antifungal properties, which help to reduce fever, alleviate respiratory issues, and treat skin infections. The therapeutic actions of Microstylis decurrens include its ability to act as a demulcent, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant, making it useful for soothing irritated tissues and relieving coughs. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
